title: AgentMux job event
description: A run event a cloud job reports to AgentMux (docs/specs/SPEC_JOBS_AND_TEMPLATES_2026_10_24.md section 4). The JSON body is at most 8 KB. It travels in an envelope with the reporter's public key (base64) and an Ed25519 signature (base64) over the bytes 'agentmux-job-event-v1', NUL, job_id, NUL, run_id, NUL, event_id, NUL, and the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the body exactly as sent. AgentMux counts an event only if the operator pinned that key as a reporter and an approved cloud job names it for that job_id; anything else is dropped. summary and link labels are shown as text and never become an instruction.

event_id.description: Unique for each event; a repeat is ignored.

job_id.description: publisher.name; must match an approved cloud job.

run_id.description: The same for a run's start, heartbeats and finish.

at.description: Milliseconds since the epoch when it happened. Events older than 7 days are refused.

scheduled_for.description: The slot this run is for, in milliseconds since the epoch, so a late run can be matched to the slot AgentMux marked missed.

infra.description: Finished only: whether the infrastructure did its part.

outcome.description: Finished only: what the run found.
